quote: Extremely short skirts, some as much as eight inches above the knee, were observed in Britain in the summer of 1962.
quote_en: Extremely short skirts, some as much as eight inches above the knee, were observed in Britain in the summer of 1962.

quote: In August 1961, Life published a photograph of two Seattle students at the University of Hawaiʻi wearing above-the-knee garments called "kookie-muus", an abbreviated version of the traditionally concealing muumuu, and noted a "current teen-age fad for short skirts" that was pushing hemlines well above the knee.
quote_en: In August 1961, Life published a photograph of two Seattle students at the University of Hawaiʻi wearing above-the-knee garments called "kookie-muus", an abbreviated version of the traditionally concealing muumuu, and noted a "current teen-age fad for short skirts" that was pushing hemlines well above the knee.

quote: Skirts three or four inches above the knee were spotted during the Spring 1962 Paris couture showings, prompting a soundly negative response from American Vogue.
quote_en: Skirts three or four inches above the knee were spotted during the Spring 1962 Paris couture showings, prompting a soundly negative response from American Vogue.

quote: The earliest known reference to the miniskirt is in a humorous 1962 article datelined Mexico City and describing the "mini-skirt" or "Ya-Ya" as a controversial item of clothing that was the latest thing on the production line there.
quote_en: The earliest known reference to the miniskirt is in a humorous 1962 article datelined Mexico City and describing the "mini-skirt" or "Ya-Ya" as a controversial item of clothing that was the latest thing on the production line there.

quote: The style came into prominence in Australia when Jean Shrimpton wore a short white shift dress, made by Colin Rolfe, on 30 October 1965 at Derby Day, first day of the annual Melbourne Cup Carnival in Australia, where it caused a sensation.
quote_en: The style came into prominence in Australia when Jean Shrimpton wore a short white shift dress, made by Colin Rolfe, on 30 October 1965 at Derby Day, first day of the annual Melbourne Cup Carnival in Australia, where it caused a sensation.

quote: In the Soviet Union, miniskirts became widely known after the 1967 Moscow International Fashion Festival
quote_en: In the Soviet Union, miniskirts became widely known after the 1967 Moscow International Fashion Festival

quote: In 1968, the Youth League of Tanzania's ruling TANU party launched Operation Vijana. Organised and run by young men, Vijana was a morality campaign targeting indecent clothing, which led to attacks on women with at least one stoning reportedly triggered by the victim's miniskirt.
quote_en: In 1968, the Youth League of Tanzania's ruling TANU party launched Operation Vijana. Organised and run by young men, Vijana was a morality campaign targeting indecent clothing, which led to attacks on women with at least one stoning reportedly triggered by the victim's miniskirt.

quote: Park Chung Hee, ruler of South Korea, signed a law in 1973 that banned miniskirts, described specifically as the hem "17 centimeters or higher above their knees".
quote_en: Park Chung Hee, ruler of South Korea, signed a law in 1973 that banned miniskirts, described specifically as the hem "17 centimeters or higher above their knees".

quote: Oficialment, però, es considera que la primera minifaldilla va aparèixer el 1962 en una boutique anomenada Bazaar, a King's Road, al barri de Chelsea, a Londres.
quote_en: Officially, though, the first miniskirt is considered to have appeared in 1962 in a boutique called Bazaar, on King's Road in Chelsea, London.

quote: El dissenyador Jacques Delahaye va provar de llençar la minifaldilla a França des del 1963, però encara devia ser massa prematur i no va tenir gens d'èxit.
quote_en: The designer Jacques Delahaye tried to launch the miniskirt in France from 1963, but it was probably still too early and it had no success.

quote: Finalment, el 1965, Mary Quant va incloure la mini a la seva col·lecció i va obtenir un èxit immediat, primer com a símbol del Swinging London, tot seguit per tot Europa i després a tot Occident. A alguns llocs, com als Països Baixos, va ser prohibida en un primer moment perquè la trobaven massa provocativa.
quote_en: Finally, in 1965, Mary Quant included the mini in her collection and had an immediate success, first as a symbol of Swinging London, then across Europe and then the whole West. In some places, such as the Netherlands, it was banned at first because it was found too provocative.

quote: Quan Twiggy va visitar el Japó el 1967 va provocar una expansió extraordinària de la moda de la mini en aquell país.
quote_en: When Twiggy visited Japan in 1967 she caused an extraordinary expansion of the mini fashion in that country.

quote: En butiksindehaver på Oxford Street i London begyndte i 1960 at lade sine vinduesmannequiner bære skørter som sluttede en tomme over knæet, hvilket hans kunder syntes godt om.
quote_en: A shop owner on Oxford Street in London began in 1960 to have his window mannequins wear skirts ending an inch above the knee, which his customers liked.

quote: I august 1961 kunne man i magasinet Life læse en artikel med et foto af to studerende på University of Hawaii med skørter, såkaldte "kookie-muus", der sluttede over knæet, og en tilhørende tekst om, hvordan korte skørter nu var en modedille blandt teenagere.
quote_en: In August 1961 Life magazine carried an article with a photo of two University of Hawaii students in skirts called "kookie-muus" ending above the knee, with text about how short skirts were now a fad among teenagers.

quote: Første gang ordet miniskørt blev nævnt var i 1962 i en humoristisk artikel fra Mexico City, hvor "mini-skørtet" eller "ya-ya'en" blev omtalt som et upassende stykke tøj, som var sidste skrig.
quote_en: The word miniskirt was first mentioned in 1962 in a humorous article from Mexico City, where the "mini-skirt" or "ya-ya" was described as an improper garment that was the latest craze.

quote: Die Modedesignerin Mary Quant kreierte Anfang der 1960er Jahre in England kurze Röcke für die Damenmode und nannte sie „Miniskirt“ bzw. „Minirock“.
quote_en: The fashion designer Mary Quant created short skirts for women's fashion in England in the early 1960s and called them "miniskirt" or "Minirock".

quote: 29.08.1964 - Der Minirock kommt nach Deutschland.
quote_en: 29.08.1964 - The miniskirt comes to Germany.

quote: Mary Quant piti Lontoon Kings Roadilla Bazaar-nimistä vaatekauppaa, jossa hän myi suunnittelemiaan vaatteita. 1950-luvun lopulla hän alkoi kokeilla lyhyempiä hameita, mikä päätyi vuonna 1965 minihameeseen, josta tuli yksi vuosikymmenen muodin tärkeimmistä piirteistä.
quote_en: Mary Quant ran a clothes shop called Bazaar on London's King's Road, where she sold her own designs. In the late 1950s she began experimenting with shorter skirts, which ended in 1965 in the miniskirt, which became one of the decade's most important fashion features.

quote: Sen hyväksyntään vaikutti suuresti Jean Shrimptonin esiintyminen Colin Rolfen suunnittelemassa valkoisessa minihamepituisessa mekossa 30. lokakuuta 1965 vuosittaisen Melbourne Cup -karnevaalin ensimmäisenä päivänä Australiassa, missä vaate aiheutti sensaation.
quote_en: Its acceptance was greatly influenced by Jean Shrimpton appearing in a white mini-length dress designed by Colin Rolfe on 30 October 1965, the first day of the annual Melbourne Cup carnival in Australia, where the garment caused a sensation.

quote: La première minijupe est commercialisée en 1962 dans une boutique appelée Bazaar sur King's Road dans le quartier de Chelsea à Londres.
quote_en: The first miniskirt was sold in 1962 in a shop called Bazaar on King's Road in the Chelsea district of London.

quote: Le styliste Jacques Delahaye avait essayé de lancer la minijupe dès 1963 en France, mais il était encore trop tôt et ce lancement ne connut aucun succès.
quote_en: The designer Jacques Delahaye had tried to launch the miniskirt as early as 1963 in France, but it was still too early and the launch had no success.

quote: Sa visite au Japon en 1967 y aura pour conséquence un engouement pour la minijupe.
quote_en: Her visit to Japan in 1967 led to a craze for the miniskirt there.

quote: Le 8 mai 2007, le député polonais Artur Zawisza dépose une proposition de loi « visant à réprimer les tentations sexuelles, incluant en cela le port de la minijupe, les décolletés généreux, les chemisiers transparents ou les maquillages insistants ».
quote_en: On 8 May 2007, the Polish MP Artur Zawisza tabled a bill "aimed at suppressing sexual temptations, including the wearing of miniskirts, generous necklines, transparent blouses or heavy make-up".

quote: Le 17 septembre 2008, Nasba Buturo, ministre ougandais de l’éthique et de l’intégrité, déclare que les minijupes devaient être interdites, arguant que ce vêtement distrairait les conducteurs et serait la cause de nombreux accidents.
quote_en: On 17 September 2008, Nsaba Buturo, Ugandan minister of ethics and integrity, declared that miniskirts should be banned, arguing the garment would distract drivers and cause many accidents.

quote: Le 29 mars 2012, Suryadharma Ali, ministre des affaires religieuses de l'Indonésie, plus grand pays musulman du monde, compare le port de la minijupe à de la pornographie.
quote_en: On 29 March 2012, Suryadharma Ali, Indonesia's minister of religious affairs, compared wearing the miniskirt to pornography.

quote: מנהל של חנות בלונדון ברחוב אוקספורד החל ניסוי ב-1960 במכירת חצאית עם מכפלות מעל הברך על גבי בובות בחלון הראווה וציין כמה חיובי הלקוחות שלו הגיבו.
quote_en: In 1960 a manager of a shop on Oxford Street in London began experimenting with selling skirts with above-the-knee hems on window mannequins and noted how positively his customers reacted.

quote: הסגנון עלה לגדולה כאשר ג'יין שרימפטון לבשה שמלת מיני קצרה לבנה שעוצבה על ידי קולין רולף, ב-30 באוקטובר 1965 ביום הדרבי, היום הראשון בקרנבל גביע מלבורן באוסטרליה.
quote_en: The style rose to prominence when Jean Shrimpton wore a short white mini dress designed by Colin Rolfe on 30 October 1965, Derby Day, the first day of the Melbourne Cup carnival in Australia.

quote: ב-1967 Rudi Gernreich היה בין ראשוני המעצבים האמריקאים שהציעו חצאיות מיני, למרות גינוי חריף וביקורת מצד מעצבים אמריקאיים כמו James Galanos ו-Norman Norell.
quote_en: In 1967 Rudi Gernreich was among the first American designers to offer miniskirts, despite sharp condemnation and criticism from American designers such as James Galanos and Norman Norell.

quote: בשנת 2009 Joice Mujuru, סגן הנשיא של זימבבואה היה צריך להתמודד עם האיסור ללבישת חצאיות מיני ומכנסיים לנשים באפריקה.
quote_en: In 2009 Joice Mujuru, vice president of Zimbabwe, had to deal with the ban on women wearing miniskirts and trousers in Africa.

quote: בשנת 2010 ראש העיר של קסטלמארה די סטביה באיטליה הזמין את המשטרה לקנוס נשים בלבוש "קצר מאוד" ובחצאיות מיני.
quote_en: In 2010 the mayor of Castellammare di Stabia in Italy invited the police to fine women dressed in "very short" clothes and miniskirts.

quote: בסוף פברואר 2010, קבוצה של כ-200 נשים אוגנדיות הפגינו נגד מה שנקרא "חוק חצאית מיני", חקיקה אנטי-פורנוגרפית אשר אסרה באופן ספציפי על נשים להתלבש "בצורה שנועדה מינית לרגש"
quote_en: In late February 2010 a group of about 200 Ugandan women protested against the so-called "miniskirt law", anti-pornography legislation that specifically banned women from dressing "in a way intended to sexually arouse".

quote: בשנות ה-2000 היה איסור על חצאיות מיני למורות של מכללת Kemerovo ברוסיה.
quote_en: In the 2000s there was a ban on miniskirts for women teachers at Kemerovo college in Russia.

quote: लंदन के ऑक्सफोर्ड स्ट्रीट में एक अनाम दुकान के प्रबंधक ने 1960 में खिड़की के पुतलों पर घुटनों से एक इंच ऊपर स्कर्ट की हेमलाइन के साथ प्रयोग करना शुरू किया और देखा कि उनके ग्राहकों ने कितनी सकारात्मक प्रतिक्रिया दी।
quote_en: In 1960 the manager of an unnamed shop on Oxford Street in London began experimenting with skirt hemlines one inch above the knee on window mannequins and noticed how positively his customers responded.

quote: अगस्त 1961 में, लाइफ ने हवाई विश्वविद्यालय में दो सिएटल के छात्रों की एक तस्वीर प्रकाशित की, जो घुटने के ऊपर के कपड़े पहने हुए थे, जिन्हें "कूकी-मूस" कहा जाता था, जो पारंपरिक रूप से छुपाने वाले मुमुऊ का संक्षिप्त रूप था, और "छोटी स्कर्ट के लिए वर्तमान किशोर-युग की सनक" का उल्लेख किया, जो हेमलाइन को घुटने से काफी ऊपर धकेल रही थी।
quote_en: In August 1961, Life published a photo of two students at the University of Hawaii wearing above-the-knee garments called "kookie-muus" and noted the current teenage craze for short skirts pushing hemlines well above the knee.

quote: मिनीस्कर्ट का सबसे पहला ज्ञात संदर्भ 1962 के एक हास्यपूर्ण लेख में है, जो मेक्सिको सिटी से प्रकाशित हुआ था और "मिनी-स्कर्ट" या "या-या" को एक विवादास्पद वस्त्र के रूप में प्रस्तुत करता था, जो वहाँ के उत्पादन लाइन पर नया था।
quote_en: The earliest known reference to the miniskirt is in a humorous 1962 article published from Mexico City, presenting the "mini-skirt" or "ya-ya" as a controversial garment, new on the production line there.

quote: यह शैली ऑस्ट्रेलिया में तब प्रमुखता में आई जब जीन श्रिम्पटन ने 30 अक्टूबर 1965 को डर्बी डे पर कॉलिन रॉल्फ द्वारा बनाई गई एक छोटी सफेद शिफ्ट ड्रेस पहनी, जो ऑस्ट्रेलिया में वार्षिक मेलबर्न कप कार्निवल का पहला दिन था, जहाँ इसने सनसनी मचा दी।
quote_en: The style rose to prominence in Australia when Jean Shrimpton wore a short white shift dress by Colin Rolfe on 30 October 1965, Derby Day, the first day of the annual Melbourne Cup Carnival in Australia, where it caused a sensation.

quote: Ժան Շրիմփթոնը, որը 1965 թվականին Մելբուրնում տեղի ունեցած ձիարշավին կրել էր մինի շրջազգեստ, ինչը սենսացիա էր առաջացրել
quote_en: Jean Shrimpton, who wore a mini dress at the horse race held in Melbourne in 1965, which caused a sensation

quote: L'origine della prima gonna dichiaratamente "mini" è generalmente accreditata nel 1963 per opera della stilista britannica Mary Quant, che fu ispirata dall'automobile Mini e che, a partire dalla fine degli anni cinquanta, aveva iniziato a proporre abiti sempre più corti.
quote_en: The origin of the first skirt expressly called a "mini" is generally credited to 1963, by the British designer Mary Quant, who was inspired by the Mini car and had been offering ever shorter dresses since the late 1950s.

quote: In Francia per esempio il designer francese André Courrèges è spesso citato come inventore della mini-jupe (aveva presentato degli abiti che terminavano sopra il ginocchio a partire dalla sua collezione del 1964 e li accorciò ulteriormente in quella del 1965, introducendo la "mini" nell'alta moda)
quote_en: In France, for example, the French designer André Courrèges is often cited as the inventor of the mini-jupe (he had shown dresses ending above the knee from his 1964 collection and shortened them further in 1965, introducing the "mini" into haute couture)

quote: La stessa Jean Shrimpton fu al centro di un piccolo scandalo mediatico relativo alla nuova moda: il 30 ottobre del 1965, durante un tour promozionale sponsorizzato dal Victoria Racing Club e da un produttore locale di tessuti, si presentò all'ippodromo Flemington Racecourse di Melbourne
quote_en: Jean Shrimpton herself was at the centre of a small media scandal over the new fashion: on 30 October 1965, during a promotional tour sponsored by the Victoria Racing Club and a local fabric maker, she appeared at Flemington Racecourse in Melbourne

quote: Per quello che riguarda l'Italia, la minigonna inizia a diffondersi nel 1966 (nelle sfilate di moda fiorentine a palazzo Pitti la lunghezza era di 10 cm sopra il ginocchio)
quote_en: As for Italy, the miniskirt began to spread in 1966 (in the Florentine fashion shows at Palazzo Pitti the length was 10 cm above the knee)

quote: resero più rigida l'applicazione delle già esistenti norme di ingresso e vietarono di fatto alle donne con la gonna al di sopra del ginocchio l'accesso a diversi edifici della città, tra cui la Basilica di San Pietro e i Musei Vaticani (tra le persone respinte, nell'agosto del 1969, vi fu anche la principessa del Belgio, Paola Ruffo di Calabria)
quote_en: they tightened the existing entry rules and de facto banned women with skirts above the knee from several buildings of the city, including St Peter's Basilica and the Vatican Museums (those turned away in August 1969 included Princess Paola Ruffo di Calabria of Belgium)

quote: 1959年にロンドンのストリート・デザイナーマリー・クヮントが若者向けに売り出し、大ヒットする。
quote_en: In 1959 the London street designer Mary Quant marketed it to young people and it was a huge hit.

quote: 1962年には英国の学生が、膝上8インチのスカートをはいている記事が、新聞に掲載されている。
quote_en: In 1962 a newspaper published an article about British students wearing skirts 8 inches above the knee.

quote: さらなる世界的な流行の火付け役は、フランスのファッションデザイナー、アンドレ・クレージュによる1965年1月の発表であった。彼はその前年の1964年8月にもミニスカートを発表している。
quote_en: The spark for further worldwide popularity was the January 1965 presentation by French designer André Courrèges. He had also presented miniskirts in August of the previous year, 1964.

quote: 1965年（昭和40年）8月11日、帝人が日本で初めてのミニスカート「テイジンエル」を発売。
quote_en: On 11 August 1965, Teijin released Japan's first miniskirt, the 'Teijinel'.

quote: Mini sijonų populiarumą labai padidino tuometinis supermodelis Jean Shrimpton, dėvėjusi Colin Rolfe sukurtą mini sijoną 1965 m. lapkritį Australijoje vykusiose Melbourne Cup varžybose ir sukėlusi didžiulę sensaciją.
quote_en: The popularity of miniskirts was greatly increased by the then supermodel Jean Shrimpton, who wore a mini skirt designed by Colin Rolfe in November 1965 at the Melbourne Cup races in Australia, causing a huge sensation.

quote: In het Britse tijdschrift "Vogue" werd in 1962 voor het eerst een foto van een vrouw in minirok gepubliceerd.
quote_en: In the British magazine "Vogue" a photo of a woman in a miniskirt was published for the first time in 1962.

quote: Bilder av moderne miniskjørt skal første gang ha blitt publisert i den britiske utgaven av Vogue i 1962
quote_en: Pictures of modern miniskirts are said to have first been published in the British edition of Vogue in 1962

event: worn by Swedish band in photo
quote: Det svenske jentebandet Ladybirds fotografert i Bergen sommeren 1968. Medlemmene er iført moteriktige antrekk, blant annet med miniskjørt.
quote_en: The Swedish girl band Ladybirds photographed in Bergen in the summer of 1968. The members wear fashionable outfits, including miniskirts.

quote: A minissaia foi definida como o símbolo da moda "Swinging London" na década de 1960.
quote_en: The miniskirt was defined as the symbol of "Swinging London" fashion in the 1960s.

quote: Так, в репортаже Montreal Gazette от 28 мая 1960 года упоминался магазин одежды на Оксфорд-стрит в Лондоне, владелец которого экспериментировал с юбками на дюйм выше колена на манекенах и отмечал положительную реакцию покупателей.
quote_en: A Montreal Gazette report of 28 May 1960 mentioned a clothes shop on Oxford Street in London whose owner experimented with skirts an inch above the knee on mannequins and noted a positive customer reaction.

quote: Первое упоминание слова «miniskirt» в английском языке также датируется 1962 годом и упоминается в статье в Billings Gazette, описывающей юбки «Ya-Ya», производимые в Мехико.
quote_en: The first mention of the word 'miniskirt' in English also dates from 1962, in a Billings Gazette article describing 'Ya-Ya' skirts produced in Mexico City.

quote: летом следующего, 1962 года, в Великобритании начали носить юбки длиной вплоть до 8 дюймов выше колен
quote_en: in the summer of the following year, 1962, skirts up to 8 inches above the knee began to be worn in Great Britain

quote: Проникновению британской моды на мини в США в 1964 году способствовала волна битломании.
quote_en: The penetration of British mini fashion into the USA in 1964 was helped by the wave of Beatlemania.

quote: Росту популярности мини-юбки способствовало появление английской модели Джин Шримптон в коротком платье во время скачек в Мельбурне в 1965 году, которое произвело сенсацию.
quote_en: The rise in popularity of the miniskirt was helped by English model Jean Shrimpton appearing in a short dress at the races in Melbourne in 1965, which caused a sensation.

quote: В СССР мини-юбки и платья получили распространение после состоявшегося в 1967 году Международного фестиваля моды
quote_en: In the USSR miniskirts and dresses spread after the International Fashion Festival held in 1967

quote: Minikjolen populariserades för vardagligt bruk under det tidiga 1960-talet av modeskapare som Mary Quant i Storbritannien och André Courrèges i Frankrike.
quote_en: The miniskirt was popularised for everyday use in the early 1960s by designers such as Mary Quant in the United Kingdom and André Courrèges in France.

quote: Minikjolen populariserades för vardagligt bruk under det tidiga 1960-talet av modeskapare som Mary Quant i Storbritannien och André Courrèges i Frankrike.
quote_en: The miniskirt was popularised for everyday use in the early 1960s by designers such as Mary Quant in the United Kingdom and André Courrèges in France.

quote: I en opinionsundersökning i USA 1967 svarade 70 % av tillfrågade vuxna att de skulle ha invändningar om deras dotter skulle bära minikjol.
quote_en: In an opinion poll in the USA in 1967, 70% of adults surveyed said they would object if their daughter wore a miniskirt.

quote: År 2014 förbjöds bärandet av bland annat minikjolar i offentligheten i Uganda, enligt en lag för att ”förhindra sexuell upphetsning”; lagen avskaffades 2021, då den bedömdes strida mot landets grundlag.
quote_en: In 2014 wearing miniskirts among other things in public was banned in Uganda under a law to "prevent sexual arousal"; the law was repealed in 2021 when it was found to violate the constitution.

quote: మినీ స్కర్టు బాహుళ్యం 1960లలో స్వింగింగ్ లండన్లో పతాకస్థాయికి చేరుకుంది.
quote_en: The popularity of the miniskirt reached its peak in Swinging London in the 1960s.

quote: Мері Квант мала магазин одягу Bazaar в Лондоні. З кінця 1950-х вона почала експериментувати з укороченими моделями спідниць, результатом чого стала поява мініспідниці 1965 року.
quote_en: Mary Quant had a clothing shop Bazaar in London. From the late 1950s she began experimenting with shortened skirts, resulting in the appearance of the miniskirt in 1965.

quote: в короткій сукні під час перегонів у Мельбурні 1965 року, що викликало сенсацію
quote_en: in a short dress at the races in Melbourne in 1965, which caused a sensation

quote: The early, pre-fame work of designer Vivienne Westwood helped pioneer the look of early British punk with her scene-establishing clothing shops Sex and Seditionaries in the mid-1970s, co-run with Malcolm McLaren who managed the Sex Pistols.
